row.text:
Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. One day, she went to a restaurant with her mommy and daddy. When they got there, Lily spilled some juice on her dress. Her mommy gave her a napkin to wipe it off.

After they ate, Lily felt very tired. She asked her mommy if they could go home so she could take a nap. Her mommy said yes and they left the restaurant.

When they got home, Lily's mommy sent her to her room to take a nap. Lily slept for a long time and when she woke up, her face was pale because she was still very tired. But then she remembered that she had a fun day with her mommy and daddy and that made her happy again. The end.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily who loved to play with her toys. One day, she was playing with her dolls when her mom called her for lunch. Lily was nervous because she didn't want to stop playing.

"Lily, it's time for lunch," said her mom.

"I don't want to stop playing," said Lily.

"You have to surrender your toys for a little while and come eat," said her mom.

Lily didn't want to surrender her toys, but she knew she had to. She put her dolls away and went to eat lunch with her mom. After lunch, Lily went back to playing with her dolls. The result of surrendering her toys was that she got to eat a yummy lunch and then continue playing with her toys.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She liked to play with her toys and eat candy. One day, Lily went to the store with her mommy. They walked around and looked at all the things in the store. 

Suddenly, Lily saw a boy who was being very naughty. He was throwing things and making a mess. Lily's mommy told her to stay away from the naughty boy. 

When they were done shopping, Lily and her mommy went to the exit. They saw a man who was wearing a big bow tie. Lily thought it looked funny and she laughed. Then, they went home and had some ice cream. The end.

Once upon a time, there was a big jungle. Many animals lived there. One day, a little birdie saw a lion. The lion was hurt and could not move. The birdie felt sad and wanted to help the lion. So, the birdie went to other animals and asked for their help. A monkey, an elephant, and a giraffe came to help. Together, they moved the lion to a safe place. The lion was happy and thanked the animals. From that day on, the lion and the birdie became friends.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. One day, Lily's mommy gave her a gift. It was a doll with a pretty dress. Lily was so happy and hugged her mommy. "Thank you, mommy! This is the best gift ever!" she said.

Later that day, Lily's friend, Tommy, came over to play. Lily wanted to show Tommy her new doll. "Tommy, look at my new doll! My mommy gave it to me as a gift," she said. Tommy looked at the doll and said, "Wow, Lily! That's a very thoughtful gift from your mommy. Let's play with your doll together!" 

Lily and Tommy played with the doll and had so much fun. They pretended the doll was a princess and they were her knights. They watched the doll dance and sing. Lily was happy that she had such a good friend like Tommy. And she was grateful for her mommy's thoughtful gift.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play outside and collect pretty rocks. One day, she found a shiny jar that was ready to be filled with her treasures. 

But then, a big dog came running towards her and scared her. Lily dropped the jar and it broke into many pieces. She started to frown and feel sad. 

Lily tried to put the pieces back together, but it was too late. She couldn't fix the jar and all her pretty rocks were lost. She felt very upset and cried. 

From that day on, Lily learned to be careful with her things and to watch out for big dogs. She also learned that accidents can happen and sometimes things can't be fixed.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to play outside in his backyard. One day, he found a big rock. The rock was dull and gray, but Timmy thought it was cool.

Timmy's sister, Sarah, came outside to play too. But she didn't like the rock. She thought it was ugly. So, Sarah started to tease Timmy about his rock. She said it was too small and not shiny enough.

Timmy felt sad and didn't want to play with the rock anymore. But then, his mom came outside and saw what was happening. She told Sarah to stop teasing Timmy and to be nice. Sarah apologized and Timmy felt happy again. He picked up the rock and showed it to his mom. She thought it was great and they all played together outside. The end.

Once upon a time, there was a kind girl named Lily. She loved to eat apples and would pick them from the tree in her backyard. One day, she went for a walk in the forest and got lost. She didn't know which way to go. 

Lily saw a man walking by and asked him for help. He was compassionate and gave her a compass to help her find her way back home. Lily followed the compass and guessed which way to go. After a while, she found her way back home and was happy to eat her apples again. 

From that day on, Lily always carried a compass with her whenever she went for a walk in the forest. She knew that if she ever got lost again, she could use it to find her way back home.

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to play basketball with his friends. One day, Timmy went to the park to play basketball with his friends. He brought his long basketball with him. 

While playing, Timmy slipped on a banana peel and fell down. His friends rushed to help him up. They saw that his basketball had rolled away. They all looked for it together and found it behind a tree. 

Timmy was happy to have his basketball back. He thanked his friends for helping him and they continued playing. From that day on, Timmy made sure to watch where he was walking so he wouldn't slip again.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play outside with her friends and her dog, Max. One day, Lily and Max were playing when suddenly Max had an emergency. He couldn't breathe and started to have a fit. 

Lily knew she had to do something to help Max. She ran inside to tell her mommy and daddy what was happening. They called the vet and rushed Max to the animal hospital. 

After a few hours, the vet was able to help Max and he was feeling much better. Lily was so happy that Max was okay. She gave him a big hug and said, "I love you, Max. You're my best friend." Max wagged his tail and licked her face. Lily knew that Max was going to be okay and they could play together again soon.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play with her toys and make up stories. One day, she found a magic wand in her toy box. She waved it around and said "Abracadabra!" but nothing happened. She tried again and again, but the wand refused to work.

Lily was sad and frustrated. She wanted to do magic like the fairy tales she read. She asked her mom for help, but she didn't know how to use the wand either. Lily refused to give up and kept trying.

After many tries, Lily finally figured out the magic word. She waved the wand and said "Bippity Boppity Boo!" Suddenly, her toys came to life and danced around her room. It was perfect! Lily was so happy that she giggled and danced with her toys all night long. From that day on, Lily knew that if she refused to give up, she could make her own magic.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to play outside with his friends. One day, Timmy and his friends decided to play a game of catch. Timmy tried his best to catch the ball, but it kept slipping out of his hands. 

Suddenly, the ball flew over Timmy's head and landed in a nearby net. Timmy ran over to the net and tried to get the ball out, but it was stuck. He pulled and pulled, but the ball wouldn't budge. 

Timmy's friends came over to help him. They all tried to get the ball out of the net, but it was no use. Timmy's arm started to hurt from pulling so hard. Just when they thought they would never get the ball back, Timmy's big brother came to the rescue. He easily got the ball out of the net and gave it back to Timmy. Timmy was so happy and grateful to his brother for helping him.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved flowers and had a big vase in her room. One day, her friend Timmy came to visit. "Look at my vase!" Lily said, pointing to the colorful flowers inside. "Wow, that's so pretty!" Timmy said, enthusiastic about the flowers.

Suddenly, there was a knock on the door. It was Lily's mom, who had arrived home from work. "Hi, Mom!" Lily said, running to give her a hug. "What a beautiful vase you have!" her mom exclaimed. "Thank you!" Lily said, beaming with pride.

Later that day, Lily and Timmy played outside. "I'm so happy you came to visit," Lily said. "Me too," Timmy replied, enthusiastic about spending time with his friend. As the sun began to set, Timmy's mom arrived to pick him up. "Goodbye, Lily!" Timmy said, waving goodbye. "Goodbye, Timmy!" Lily said, waving back. She couldn't wait to show him her vase again the next time he visited.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to watch big machines move things around, especially cranes. One day, Timmy and his mom went to the park to watch the construction workers build a new playground. Timmy was so excited to see the crane move heavy things and build new things.

But then, something happened. The crane got stuck in the mud and couldn't move. The workers tried and tried, but they couldn't get it out. Timmy was sad because he thought the workers wouldn't be able to finish building the playground. 

But then, something amazing happened. Another big machine came to help the crane get unstuck! The workers were able to finish building the playground, and Timmy was so happy. He ran up to the workers and said, "Thank you for finishing the playground!" Even though the crane got stuck and it was boring to watch, it all worked out in the end.

Once upon a time, there was a big, strong man with a big, strong mustache. He was very proud of his mustache and would comb it every day. One day, he went to the park to play with his friends. He was having so much fun that he didn't notice his mustache had fallen off. He looked and looked but he couldn't find it anywhere. He felt sad because he loved his mustache so much. But then his friends helped him look and they found it in the grass. He was so happy to have his mustache back on his face.

Once upon a time, there was a clever little boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to play with his toy cars at the port. He would watch the big boats come and go, and dream of sailing away on one someday.

One day, while Timmy was playing, a seagull disturbed him by flying too close to his face. Timmy got scared and ran away, but he quickly came back to his cars when he realized the seagull was gone.

As Timmy played, he noticed that one of his cars was missing a wheel. He looked around and saw that the wheel had fallen into the water at the port. Timmy cleverly used a stick to fish the wheel out of the water and put it back on his car.

From that day on, Timmy made sure to keep his cars away from the seagulls so they wouldn't disturb him again. And whenever he played at the port, he made sure to be extra careful with his toys so he wouldn't lose any more parts. The end.

Once upon a time, there was a lively little boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to play outside and run around with his friends. One day, Timmy's friend Billy came over to play. 

"Hi Timmy!" said Billy. "What do you want to do today?" 

"I want to play with my new missile toy!" said Timmy, showing Billy his new toy. 

"That looks cool!" said Billy. "Can I play with it too?" 

"Sure!" said Timmy. "Let's wrap it up in this blanket so we can pretend it's a secret weapon." 

So, Timmy and Billy wrapped up the missile toy and ran around the yard pretending to be secret agents on a mission. They had so much fun together that they didn't even notice when it started to rain. 

"Uh oh, we better go inside before we get wet!" said Timmy. 

"Good idea!" said Billy. "Let's go play inside." 

And so, Timmy and Billy spent the rest of the day playing inside, having just as much fun as they did outside. The end.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to draw and write in her journal. One day, Lily's mom asked her to clean her room. 

Lily said, "But mom, my room is already tidy!" 

Her mom replied, "I know, but can you please step on the toys and put them away?" 

Lily giggled and said, "Okay, mom!" She stepped on the toys and put them away in their proper place. 

After she was done, Lily went back to her journal and drew a picture of her clean and tidy room. She showed her mom and said, "Look, mom! My room is so pretty now!" 

Her mom smiled and said, "Good job, Lily! Your room looks great!"

Once upon a time, there was a little fish named Nemo. Nemo loved to swim in the big blue ocean. One day, Nemo saw a piece of gum floating in the water. He thought it looked yummy, but his mom told him not to eat it because it was bad for him.

Nemo was feeling adventurous and wanted to explore the wild ocean. He decided to dive deep down to see what he could find. As he swam deeper, he saw all kinds of colorful fish and plants. He even saw a big, scary shark! Nemo quickly swam away and made it back to his home safely.

From that day on, Nemo learned that it's important to listen to his mom and not eat things that aren't good for him. He also realized that the ocean can be a wild and exciting place, but it's important to be careful and stay safe.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play outside and explore the woods behind her house. One day, she found a smooth rock that was perfect for skipping on the lake. 

As she was skipping the rock, she heard a whisper coming from the bushes. "Who's there?" she asked. A little squirrel poked his head out and said, "Hi, my name is Sammy. I like to play too!" 

Lily was so happy to have made a new friend. They played together for a long time until it started to get dark. "I have to go home now," Lily said. "But we can play again tomorrow!" 

Sammy nodded and whispered, "Okay, see you tomorrow!" Lily skipped home, holding her new smooth rock tightly in her hand, excited to come back and play with Sammy again.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She had a black cat named Mittens. One day, Lily was playing with Mittens and she dropped her toy. Mittens went to get it for her, but he got into trouble. He accidentally knocked over a vase and it broke into many pieces. Lily's mom was not happy, but Lily told her it was her fault because she dropped her toy. Lily's mom forgave her and they all played together with Mittens.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to ride her bike through the park. One sunny day, Lily saw a big pile of wood. She wanted to ride over it, but it was too high. So, she got off her bike and climbed up the wood. When she got to the top, she looked around and saw that the park was very quiet. It was nice to be up high and see everything. After a while, Lily climbed back down and rode her bike home. The end.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. Lily loved to play on her porch, which was painted purple. One day, Lily's friend called her on the phone and asked if she wanted to play outside. 

Lily said, "Yes, I want to play! Come over to my purple porch." 

Her friend replied, "Okay, I will come over soon." 

Lily waited on the porch for her friend to arrive. When her friend finally came, they played together and had lots of fun. They even found a purple flower in the garden. 

Lily said, "Look at this pretty purple flower!" 

Her friend said, "Wow, it's so beautiful." 

After they played for a while, Lily's friend had to go home. Lily said, "Goodbye, friend. Come play again soon!" 

Her friend replied, "I will call you later to make plans." 

Lily smiled and waved goodbye as her friend walked away. She was happy to have such a good friend to play with on her purple porch.

Once upon a time, there was a big bird. The bird was very loud and liked to sing all day long. One morning, the sun started to rise and the bird woke up. It looked out of its nest and saw the sun in the sky. The bird started to sing even louder because it was happy. The end.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to draw with pastel colors. Her mommy bought her a big box of pastels for her birthday. Lily was so happy that she hugged her mommy and said "I love you!"

One day, Lily went to the park with her mommy. There were many children playing and it was very noisy. Lily didn't like the noisy sounds. She covered her ears and said "It's too noisy here!"

But then, Lily saw a little girl who was sad because she lost her toy. Lily wanted to help her. She gave the little girl her favorite pastel drawing and said "I love you, you can have this." The little girl smiled and hugged Lily. From that day on, Lily wasn't bothered by the noisy sounds anymore. She felt happy because she helped someone and she knew that love is more important than anything else.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play outside in nature. One day, she saw a beautiful red flower. She picked it and showed it to her mom.

"Lily, that's a pretty flower," her mom said. "Let's sort it with the other flowers."

Lily and her mom sorted the flowers by color. They put the red flower with the other red flowers. Lily was happy to see all the pretty colors. She said, "Nature is so pretty!" 

Her mom smiled and said, "Yes, it is."

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. Lily loved to eat yogurt because it was yummy and healthy. One day, Lily's mommy said to her, "Lily, it's time to take a bath. You will feel clean and jolly after!"

Lily didn't want to take a bath because she was having too much fun playing with her toys. But, her mommy said, "Come on, Lily. It's important to be clean so we can stay healthy. Plus, we can have more fun after you're all clean!"

So, Lily took a bath and her mommy helped her wash her hair and body. After her bath, Lily felt so fresh and clean. Her mommy gave her a big hug and said, "Now let's go have some more yogurt and play together!" Lily smiled and said, "Yay! I love yogurt and playing with you, mommy!"

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to play hide-and-seek with his friends. One day, Timmy's friend Johnny hid in the gym and Timmy had to search for him. 

Timmy looked everywhere for Johnny. He looked behind the big red ball, under the blue mat, and even in the yellow locker. But Johnny was nowhere to be found. 

Just when Timmy was about to give up, he heard a giggle coming from behind the green curtain. He pulled the curtain back and there was Johnny, hiding behind it the whole time! Timmy was so happy he found his friend and they both laughed and played together in the gym.

Once upon a time, there was a big forest. In the forest, there was a wild lion. The lion was very hungry and wanted to eat something tasty. So, he went to a nearby farm where he saw a cow. The lion thought the cow looked delicious, so he tried to catch it. But the farmer saw the lion and quickly came to serve the lion some beef. The lion was happy and ate the beef instead of the cow. From that day on, the lion visited the farmer every time he was hungry, and the farmer always served him beef.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved going on adventures and exploring new places. One day, she heard about a big castle that was nearby. She decided to go and check it out.

As she walked towards the castle, she saw a man with a sour face. He looked like he didn't want to be bothered. Lily smiled at him and said hello, but he didn't say anything back. She thought to herself, "I hope I don't meet anyone else like him at the castle."

Finally, she arrived at the castle and was amazed by its size and beauty. As she explored the castle, she met many friendly people who showed her around. She even met a prince who invited her to a big party that night. Lily was so excited to go and couldn't wait to see what other adventures awaited her at the castle.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved playing with her toys and singing songs. One day, she saw a trumpet in her toy box. She was so excited to try it out!

Lily picked up the trumpet and blew into it. It made a loud noise that made her giggle. Her mom heard the noise and came to see what was happening. "Wow, Lily! You're playing the trumpet!" her mom said.

Lily smiled and replied, "Yes, I'm trying to play it. It's so much fun!" Her mom was happy to see Lily so excited and they both danced to the music Lily made with her trumpet. From that day on, Lily played her trumpet every day and she became very good at it.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play outside in the sunshine. One day, Lily heard a loud sound coming from the sky. It was a big, orange airplane flying overhead. 

Lily's mom came outside to warn her about the noise. She told Lily that the airplane was very loud and it could hurt her ears. Lily covered her ears and watched as the airplane flew away.

After the airplane was gone, Lily and her mom went inside and had some orange juice. Lily loved the sweet, orange juice and drank it all up. She was happy to have her mom there to warn her about the loud sound and to enjoy a yummy orange drink together. The end.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She was very sleepy and wanted to go to bed. Her mommy said, "Lily, it's time to sleep now." Lily replied, "Okay, mommy."

As she was sleeping, she heard a loud noise. She woke up and saw a big fire outside her window. She shouted, "Mommy, there's a fire!" Her mommy quickly woke up and called the firefighters.

The firefighters came and put out the fire. Lily was very scared but happy that everyone was safe. Her mommy hugged her and said, "It's okay, Lily. You're safe now." Lily felt better and went back to sleep.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily who was very hungry. She went to a restaurant with her mom and dad. The waiter gave them a menu to choose what they wanted to eat. Lily saw a picture of a big burger and fries, and her tummy growled.

But when the waiter came back, he teased Lily and said, "Are you sure you can eat all of that?" Lily felt embarrassed and sad. She whispered to her mom, "I don't like that man, he's mean." Her mom told her not to worry and ordered the burger for her.

When the food arrived, Lily was so happy and took a big bite. She smiled and said, "This is yummy!" Her dad asked her, "Do you want to share some with me?" Lily shook her head and said, "No way, I'm too hungry!"

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. Lily loved to play with marbles. She had a big bag of them, but they were always in a big mess. One day, her mom said, "Lily, let's organize your marbles. We can sort them by color." Lily didn't know what "organize" meant, but her mom showed her how to put the marbles in groups by their colors. 

After they finished, Lily could easily find the marble she wanted to play with. She was so happy! Then, Lily's mom told her a story. "Once, there was a man who couldn't sign his name. He had trouble doing important things because he couldn't sign his name. But, he learned how to sign and it helped him a lot." 

Lily listened carefully to the story and realized that learning new things is important. She decided to learn new things too. From that day on, Lily organized everything she could and practiced signing her name. She felt proud of herself and knew that organizing and learning new things can make life easier.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play hide and seek with her friends. One day, Lily's best friend Emily passed by her house to play. They went to the park to play hide and seek. Lily found a great hiding spot behind a big tree, but Emily couldn't find her. Emily started to complain that Lily was hiding too well. 

After a while, Lily got tired of hiding and wanted to play something else. She came out of her hiding spot and told Emily that they should play tag instead. Emily agreed and they had a lot of fun running around the park. They played until the sun started to set and it was time to go home. 

When they got back to Lily's house, Emily's mom was waiting for her. She asked Emily if she had fun playing with Lily. Emily smiled and said yes, but she also complained that Lily was too good at hiding. Lily's mom overheard and laughed, saying that Lily had always been good at hiding. The girls said goodbye and promised to play again soon.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved holidays because she got to play with her friends all day long. One day, Lily went to the park with her mommy and daddy. She saw a big orange ball and wanted to play with it. She asked her mommy if she could have the ball, but her mommy said no. 

Lily felt sad, but then she saw a boy playing with the same orange ball. She asked the boy if she could play with it too. The boy said yes and they played together for a while. When it was time to go home, Lily didn't want to leave the ball. She asked the boy if she could play with it again tomorrow. The boy said yes and Lily was very happy. She repeated the word "tomorrow" to herself over and over again on the way home.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She had a big, pink blanket that she loved very much. One day, Lily's mommy asked her to fold the blanket and put it away in the closet. Lily didn't know how to fold it, but her mommy showed her how to do it step by step.

After Lily folded the blanket, she put it in the chamber of the closet. She felt proud of herself for doing a good job. But then, she started spinning around and around in the room. She felt dizzy and fell down on the carpet. Her mommy came to check on her and asked if she was okay. Lily giggled and said, "I'm okay, Mommy. I just got dizzy from spinning too much!"

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy loved tea parties with his friends. One day, Timmy's mommy made him a special tea party. She hid some cookies for Timmy and his friends to find. Timmy's friends looked everywhere, but they couldn't find the cookies. Timmy knew where they were hidden, but he didn't tell his friends.

Timmy's friends were sad they couldn't find the cookies. Timmy felt bad for not telling them where they were hidden. He knew it wasn't nice to keep the cookies a secret. So, Timmy said sorry to his friends and thanked them for coming to his tea party. He also showed them where the cookies were hidden. Timmy learned that it's always better to share and be kind to others.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to run and play with his friends. One day, he and his friends went to the park to play. They ran around and laughed a lot.

Timmy's mommy told him that he needed to eat healthy food to make his muscles grow big and strong. So, Timmy ate lots of fruits and vegetables.

But sometimes, Timmy could be a little naughty. He would run away from his mommy when she tried to catch him. But when she finally caught him, they would both laugh together.

Once upon a time, there was a happy boy named Timmy. Timmy loved pastries, especially the ones his mom made. One day, Timmy's mom made a big pastry that was too heavy for her to carry. So, Timmy decided to help his mom and carried the pastry to the kitchen table. Timmy was so strong and flexible that he didn't even drop the pastry! Timmy's mom was so proud of him and gave him a big hug. From that day on, Timmy knew he could always help his mom carry heavy things.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play in her backyard and explore the world around her. One day, she found a little bird with a broken wing. 

Lily picked up the bird and took it to her mom. "Mommy, look! I found a birdie. It's hurt. Can we help it?" 

Her mom smiled and said, "Of course, sweetie. Let's take it to the vet and see what we can do." 

At the vet, the doctor weighed the bird and said, "This little guy is very light. We need to give him some medicine and a nail to help his wing heal." 

Lily watched as the doctor gave the bird some medicine and put a tiny nail in its wing. She thought the bird was so adorable and couldn't wait for it to fly again. 

After a few days of rest, the bird was ready to go back into the wild. Lily and her mom took the bird back to the backyard and watched as it flew away, happy and healthy once again.

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Timmy. He had a bike with pedals that he loved to ride. One day, he saw a girl crying on the sidewalk. He asked her what was wrong.

The girl said she was lost and didn't know how to get home. Timmy didn't know where she lived, but he wanted to help. He asked his mom for help, and she called the police. The police found the girl's home and took her there safely.

Timmy felt happy that he could help someone who was lost. He didn't want to be ignorant and not help someone who needed it. From that day on, he always tried to be kind and helpful to others.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play outside with her friends. They would run and jump and laugh all day long. One day, Lily's friend Sarah was being bossy and telling everyone what to do. Lily didn't like it when Sarah was bossy. 

Suddenly, Sarah fell down and hurt her shoulder. Lily knew she should stop playing and help her friend. She ran over to Sarah and asked if she was okay. Sarah said her shoulder hurt a lot. 

Lily knew what to do. She stopped playing and helped Sarah up. She walked her to her mom's house and told her what happened. Sarah's mom took her to the doctor and she got better soon. Lily felt happy that she could help her friend.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily who loved to play with her toys. One day, Lily's aunt came to visit her. Her aunt brought a big box with a tight lock on it. Lily was very curious and asked her aunt what was inside the box. Her aunt replied, "It's a surprise, but you can have it if you unlock the box."

Lily tried and tried to unlock the box, but she couldn't do it. She was getting frustrated and upset. Her aunt saw how upset she was and said, "Sometimes things are hard, but if you keep trying, you can do it." 

Lily took her aunt's advice and kept trying. Finally, she unlocked the box and inside was a beautiful dress. Lily was so happy and thanked her aunt. Her aunt smiled and said, "Remember, if you keep trying, you can do anything." 

Lily learned that even when things are hard, she should never give up. She felt proud of herself for unlocking the box and was excited to wear her new dress.

One day, a little girl named Lily was playing in her room. She loved to play with her dolls and teddy bear. Suddenly, her mom called her for lunch. Lily was hungry and went to the kitchen. She saw her mom cooking yummy food and she was happy.

After lunch, Lily went back to her room. She saw her curtains were dirty and needed to be washed. She asked her mom to help her clean the curtains. Her mom was happy to help and they washed the curtains together.

Later that day, Lily's dad came home from work. He saw the clean curtains and said, "Wow, these curtains look great! I enjoy looking at them." Lily felt proud and happy. She smiled and hugged her dad. She wasn't embarrassed anymore about her dirty curtains.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. One day, she went outside to play with her friends. They were having so much fun, but then Lily saw a drain. She wanted to study it, so she went closer to look. Suddenly, her ball fell into the drain! 

Lily was very sad because she thought her ball was dead. She asked her friends what to do, but they didn't know. Just then, a kind man walked by and asked what happened. Lily told him about her ball, and he said he could help. He got a long stick and fished the ball out of the drain. 

Lily was so happy and thanked the man. She learned that she should be careful around drains and that there are always kind people who can help. She went home and told her mom all about her adventure. Her mom was proud of her for being brave and for learning something new.

"Can I have it back?" Jim asked.

"Sure," Mom said, handing him the spoon. "Here you go!"

Jim smiled and scooped up a big spoonful of food to eat. He was so happy to have his spoon back.

Once upon a time, there was a little fairy. She was eager to restore her magical powers. One day, she asked a 3 year old child for help. 

"Please help me restore my magic," she said.

The child was eager to help. "I'll look for the magical items," he said. 

The child and the fairy began their search for magical items. Soon, they found a special bracelet, a sparkling wand and a shiny crown. With these items, the fairy's magic was fully restored! 

The fairy was so happy. "Thank you for your help," she said as she hugged the child. 

The child was so excited. He had helped restore a real fairy's magical powers and that made him happy!

Tommy was standing outside. He wondered what he could do. Suddenly, he saw a butterfly. The butterfly was big and blue. It flew above him.

Tommy said, "Wow! What will it do?"

The butterfly twirled around in the sky. It fluttered away. Tommy watched it go.

He put his hands on his hips and wondered, "Where will it go now?" 

Tommy waited until he saw the butterfly again. It flew back over to a nearby tree. Tommy smiled. The butterfly had returned. He said, "It came back!"

Tommy stared at the butterfly for a few minutes. Then he waved goodbye. The butterfly flew away again. It was time for Tommy to go home. He had the best day ever.

Molly and Bobby were playing together in the park. Molly had a big bowl. She rolled it along the ground and Bobby chased it. It rolled and rolled across the grass. 

"It's so cold," said Bobby, as he felt the cold air on his face. 

"Molly, can I roll the bowl?" asked Bobby. 

"Yes!" replied Molly. Bobby took the bowl and rolled it back to Molly. He laughed as it toppled over and he chased it again. 

They both ran around and rolled the bowl from one end of the park to the other. They kept rolling it until the sun went down and it was time for them to go home. 

Molly and Bobby said goodbye and headed off in opposite directions until the next day when they would play again.

Once upon a time, there was a bright red bird. She lived in a cozy nest in the tall green tree near the meadow.

One day, the bird flapped her wings and flew away. She wanted to go on an adventure!

She flew and flew until she spotted a pond. It glistened in the sunshine. She landed on the edge of the pond and looked down.

She saw a little brown fish swimming around the pond. He looked up at the red bird with his big eyes and said "hello". 

The bird smiled and asked the fish a question. "Would you like to come with me on my adventure?"

The fish was thrilled! He said, "Yes! I've been looking for an adventure too!"

The bird smiled and stuck out her leg. The fish swam closer and grasped her leg with his fins.

The bird took to the sky and released the fish over the meadow. The fish was free and so was the bird. She knew they would always be friends.

Once upon a time there was a happy little girl. She was always looking for fun things to do.

One day, the girl saw a faucet. She liked how shiny it was, so she went over to it. But when the girl touched it, it started to drip water.

The girl was scared. So she called out for help. "Please help me! Someone rescue me!"

Just then, her mom came rushing in. She saw the dripping faucet and knew it was serious. She was able to quickly fix the faucet.

The girl smiled and hugged her mom, relieved that she was safe.

"Mom, you saved me!" the girl said.

Her mom smiled proudly. "Yes, I rescued you," she said. "But we must be more careful with the faucet, okay?" 

The girl nodded, and the two of them hugged. Then the girl went off to find more new things to explore.

Mommy took me to a special hill. There were lots of rocks all around us. I could see the sun shining bright above us.

"Let's have a picnic!" she said.

We spread out a blanket and put out some food. It was yummy!

The sun was mild, so I asked Mommy if I could explore the hill. She said yes and I set off.

I found a huge rock that was the perfect size. I wanted to move it, but it was too heavy.

Then I remembered that my mommy had brought a blanket to cover the rock. So I ran to get it, and with Mommy's help, together we covered the rock so that it looked like a big furry animal.

I was so happy. We had created something special. 
Mommy said, "Let's sit here and look at our work."

I smiled and said, "Yes! Let's cover more rocks!"

John and his mom went to the cafe. John saw a big menu on the wall, and the words on it were very clear.

John said, "Mom, I want this!" He pointed to the blueberry pancake.

Mom smiled and said, "Okay, let's mark it." She marked the menu with a pencil.

Then, they asked the waiter to bring them the marked menu. 

The waiter said, "Yes, I will be back soon with the marked menu for you."

Mom smiled again. "Thank you, we will wait." 

John waited with excitement for the pancakes to come. He was happy because he knew his marked menu was coming soon!

Once upon a time, there was a little girl called Anna. She wanted to plant a pretty flower in her garden, so she went outside to look for a place to put it. Anna saw a gray patch of soil. She asked her mom, "Mama, can I plant my flower here?" Mama said "Yes, you can plant your flower in the gray soil." Anna started digging a hole in the soil and she put the flower inside. She covered it carefully with soil and watered it. Then she waited for the flower to grow.

Days later, Anna was happy to see the flower had grown. It was a beautiful pink flower with a yellow centre. Anna asked her mama, "Mama, why is the flower so pretty?" Mama said, "Because you were patient and cared for it. You chose the right place, put it in the gray soil and watered it every day." Anna smiled and said, "I'm so happy I planted the flower!"

Once upon a time, there was a sheep who had been getting a bit dull and grey. She was called Pat, and her wool was not as soft and fluffy as it used to be. She was feeling rather sad, and wasn't sure how to make things better.

One day, she decided to take a walk to ask someone for help. As she passed a field of tiny lambs, one of them stopped, looking up at Pat with their bright eyes. Pat explained how she was feeling dull and grey, and the lamb said "I think I know what you need! A bit of sun will help you sparkle up again. It will increase your energy!"

Pat was excited! She took a nap in a spot she felt sure was full of sunlight for the rest of the day. She woke feeling energized and her wool was soft and fluffy again. From that day forward, Pat made sure to take a sunbathing break each day, so her wool would never go dull again.

The end.

Once upon a time there was a boy who liked to play lots of games. His mom had a surprise for him. It was small, hidden under a blanket. 

The boy jumped up excitedly. "What's this?" He asked. 

"Let's play a game. But first you need to guess what it is," Mom said. 

The boy pondered for a moment. "Is it an animal?" He asked. 

Mom smiled. "No, it's something else," she said.

The boy thought some more and then said, "Is it a toy?"

Mom nodded. "Yes it is! It's a special toy."

The boy uncovered the blanket and saw a toy box. "Wow!" he said.

He opened the box and saw a jigsaw puzzle inside. He paused to take it all in. 

"Let's play a game," Mom said. "Let's see who can put together the puzzle first." 

The boy clapped his hands and said excitedly, "Yeah! I'll do it."

And off they went, their game of fun and puzzles about to begin.

One day, Mama and her three-year-old son, Tim, went to the park. Tim saw some children playing in the sandbox and wanted to join them.

Mama said, "Wait here and stand still. I'm going to get something from the car."

Tim waited and stood still, but he was getting impatient. When Mama came back, she was carrying two buckets filled with sand.

Mama said, "Tim, carry this bucket. It won't be too heavy for you."

Tim looked at the bucket and it seemed heavy to him. "That's too heavy, Mama," he said.

Mama looked at him, her face a bit stern. "I wouldn't ask if it was too heavy, Tim. That's rude. Can you try?"

Tim nodded and grabbed the bucket. He was surprised when he found that he couldn't lift it. But Mama had already started walking towards the sandbox, so Tim tried again. This time, he was able to stand up with the bucket in his hands. 

He smiled to himself, proud that he was able to lift the weight. Mama smiled at him too and said, "Good job, Timmy. Let's go show the other kids."

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Katie. She was three years old and very curious. One day, Katie asked her mom, "What can I do?" Her mom smiled and said, "You can help me clean up the junk in the backyard."

So, Katie put on her smock and went outside. She saw lots of junk that her mom wanted her to clean up. She was not sure how to start, but she was excited to try.

Then she saw an old bucket. She grabbed it and started to fill it with the junk. She worked hard and soon the bucket was full. She was very proud; she had completed her job!

She brought the bucket inside and her mom said, "Good job, Katie! Everything fits perfectly in here!" Katie smiled and knew that she had done a great job. She was so pleased with herself.

Once upon a time there was a nice boy called Tim. Tim loved to go to the pond to enjoy fishing. Every day he took his fishing rod, went to the pond and enjoyed catching the regular fish. 

One day, when he came to the pond an old man was already standing there with a fishing rod. 

Tim said to him "hi, I am Tim and I come here everyday to enjoy fishing." 

The old man smiled and answered him "Do you like to fish? I come here every day too."

Tim smiled and said "Yes, I love to enjoy fishing in this pond. What kind of fish do you like to catch?"

The old man said "I like to catch the regular fish here. What about you?"

Tim said "I also like to catch the regular fish. It's so much fun!"

The old man smiled again and said "you should enjoy fishing every day. It's a great hobby!"

Tim thanked the old man, said goodbye and went home happily, eagerly looking forward to the next day of enjoying fishing.

Once upon a time there was a fox who loved to swing. The fox could be seen in the park each day, enjoying the feel of the wind blowing in its fur. 

One day, a bad wolf appeared and said, "Hey Fox, why are you here all alone?"

The fox said, "I'm here to swing. Don't you like to swing too?" 

The wolf shook its head and said, "No, I don't like to swing. I like to eat foxes like you! Get ready! I'm coming to get you!"

But the fox was clever and knew that the wolf was trying to trick him. "No! I like to swing and you don't scare me!" shouted the fox.

The wolf ran away and the fox went back to having fun, safely swinging in the park. The end.

Once upon a time, there were two friends called Joe and Molly. Joe and Molly loved to play together. One day, Joe said to Molly, "Let's go get pizza!" Molly clapped her hands and was very happy. 

So, Joe and Molly went to the pizza shop. When they arrived, Molly chose a big piece of pizza and Joe chose a small one. But when Molly tried it, she said, "This pizza is bad!" Joe laughed and said, "Maybe you just don't like pizza!" 

Molly thought and then said, "Maybe I do like pizza, but this one is bad!" Joe shrugged and ate his pizza anyway. Molly was sad, but Joe said, "Let's go somewhere else. I bet they'll have better pizza!" 

So, they went to another pizza shop and this time, Molly liked her pizza a lot. She smiled and said, "This pizza is good, Joe!" Joe smiled back and said, "I told you it would be better!" And then the two friends ate their yummy pizzas and had a wonderful time.
